messages:
Kai: FYI seeing a perf spike on staging for head_dim=16 models on causal generation. p50 tokens/s dropped ~35% after the kernelpicker tweak. Anyone else?
Linh: Saw the alert this morning. I ran a quick microbench (SM86, batch=4) and reproduced locally. Looks correlated with the new kernel selection thresholds.
Rory: Can you paste the profiler snippet you have?
Kai: Pasting microbench output I captured.
```text
# microbench summary
model: small-encoder-decoder-ish
hw: SM86 A100s
batch 4 seqlen 256 head_dim 16 (12 heads)
old selector -> flashv2 causal path: 1.20M tokens/s (p50)
new selector -> picked flashv3 fallback causal: 780k tokens/s (p50)
nvprof summary: L2_spills=3200, kernel "sdpa_generic" runtime 62%
```
Linh: That L2 spill number and the sdpa_generic hotspot match an unaligned tile path in flashv3 for causal kernels when head_dim is small. Non-causal path still picks the fast kernel because its tiling handles small head dims differently.
Rory: Is this dependent on KV-cache warmup? Maybe the selector sees different seq_len distribution after first generations.
Kai: Good call. I repro'd both cold and warmed KV cases. Cold run (no KV): selector picked flashv3 and slowpath. Warm KV (after prefix) sometimes flips to a different kernel for later tokens, causing throughput instability.
Ash: perf-ci-bot already flagged a regression: INF-4721. Canary numbers show p50 latency +62% for some low-head models.
perf-ci-bot: [automated] Regression detected on canary (2026-03-15T09:12Z): p50 latency +62%. Suspected change: commit 3f2a7 (kernelpicker heuristics).
Linh: Proposed mitigations: 1) Add a head-dim alignment heuristic to the kernelpicker: prefer flashv2 causal for head_dim <= 16 (or head_dim % 32 != 0). 2) Add hysteresis so a single batch doesn't flip the selector. 3) Expose kernel_choice metrics and head_dim histograms in observability so we can track flips.
Rory: Alternatively, we can try pad-to-32 for the small head dims at compilation time and benchmark memory vs perf. Might be safer but could increase memory/regs.
Kai: I tried forcing the selector to choose flashv2 for causal when head_dim < 24. Result: p50 back to ~1.18M tokens/s, memory delta negligible at batch=4 in our test harness. Reproducer command below:
```bash
python tools/microbench.py --model small --batch 4 --seqlen 256 --heads 12 --head-dim 16 --causal --force-kernel flashv2
```
Ash: Can we do a short canary rollout with that heuristic? We'd prefer a quick config-based mitigation rather than a full revert.
Linh: I'll open a draft PR that implements the conditional in kernelpicker + unit perf test in the microbench suite. Plan: gate it behind a config flag for an initial 24h canary. Also adding an observation tag: "kernel_choice" and a per-request "head_dim" attribute so dashboards can show correlations.
Rory: Also add a small KV-cache tag: "kv_warm" (true/false) so we can separate cold vs warm selection stats. I observed selection flip after the 1st token in some runs.
Kai: Creating INF ticket INF-4721 and linking PR. I'll attach repro logs and the nvprof output.
Ash: Thanks all. Please coordinate with SRE for canary rollout and ensure perf-ci has the new microbench before we promote. :thumbsup:
perf-ci-bot: [automated] Canary scheduled: kernelpicker-heuristic-short-rollout (24h). Monitoring dashboards: kernel_choice, head_dim_hist, kv_warm_rate.
